Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As a Translational Medicine Expert (TME) you will provide medical and scientific expertise and leadership to:
• Drive success of early global programs, develop and implement strategies to achieve Transition Decision Point (TDP)
• Drive success of late global programs by developing and implementing strategies, which lead to clinical pharmacology and profiling packages that meet regulatory requirements and support differentiated and competitive drug labeling.
• Support Translational Research in developing new indications, endpoints and biomarkers, using in vitro, in vivo, or in silico methods.
• Provide scientific expert assessments and support for in-licensing opportunities, including due diligences.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Early clinical projects (Phase I / II, “Discovery”):
Develop, in collaboration with the dermatology TA and work with teams to carry out, strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects from Research to TDP in single or multiple indications, including post-indication expansion (PIE) projects.

Late-stage clinical projects (post-TDP, “Profiling”):
In collaboration with the dermatology TA Head: Act as a key leader in developing the Ph2-3 and post-approval profiling strategy for drug programs, representing TMDP on Global Project Team (GPT) along with other TM line functions. Provide support for dose selection, study design and other clinical pharmacology matters throughout the development cycle. Oversee conduct and interpretation of studies prioritized by the to support the pivotal trials, such as special populations, drug-drug interactions, mechanism of action assessments, Pediatric Investigational Plan, etc.

Translational Research (TR; indication seeking, endpoint and biomarker development):
In collaboration with the dermatology TA Head, BR Research scientists, other TM line functions (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), develop strategies to identify initial or expansion (PIE) indications, and to obtain sufficient evidence to fund these ideas.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; in-licensing and out licensing compounds):
Participate on BD&L teams as the TM representative.

General responsibilities:

• Responsible for clinical monitoring and integrated safety data review during and after the live phase of a study.

• Provides medical and scientific leadership and expertise to all line functions on the study team.

• Represent clinical Translational Medicine aspects to Health Authorities and other stakeholders (e.g. payers, patient advocacy groups).

• Oversee publication strategy for TM studies; lead writing of scientific publications; present study results externally where appropriate

Leadership:

• Lead study-specific teams/ clinical trial teams in partnership with other line functions.

• Lead BR-sub-team(s) on Global Project Teams for late-phase programs

• Collaborate closely with other TM (especially CS&I) and non-TM (especially Project Management) line functions to ensure operational excellence, continued urgency, and close attention to timelines, costs, and subject burden in balance with high scientific standards and innovation

Essential Requirements:

• Doctoral degree, MD

• Board certified Dermatologist

• Preferably Ph.D. within dermatology/immunology

• At least 5 years’ experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech company, CRO, or academic medical center, or related experience

• Innovation: Seeks out new clinical discovery opportunities and approaches to reach TDP

• Recognized expert in field, driving success for individual studies and projects; respected by colleagues across R&D, Development, and externally

• Fluent oral and written English

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• 122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annua

Descrizione del lavoro Riepilogo #LI-Hybrid Ubicazione: Basel, Switzerland

Come esperto di medicina traslazionale (TME) fornirete competenze mediche e scientifiche e leadership per: - Guidare il successo dei primi programmi globali, sviluppare e attuare strategie per raggiungere Transition Decision Point (TDP) - Guidare il successo dei programmi di fine globale sviluppando e implementando strategie, che portano alla farmacologia clinica e pacchetti di affrancatura che soddisfano i requisiti normativi e supportano l'etichettatura differenziata e competitiva dei farmaci. - Supporto Ricerca traslazionale nello sviluppo di nuove indicazioni, endpoint e biomarcatori, utilizzando metodi in vitro, in vivo o in silico.

- fornire valutazioni scientifiche di esperti e sostegno per le opportunità di licenza, comprese le dovute diligence.

Descrizione del lavoro

Responsabilità chiave: Progetti clinici precoci (fase I / II, Discovery.): - Sviluppare, in collaborazione con la dermatologia TA e lavorare con team per effettuare, strategie per la componente Medicina Traduttiva dei progetti di sviluppo di droga dalla Ricerca al TDP in singole o multiple indicazioni, compresi i progetti di espansione post-indicazione (PIE).

Progetti clinici in fase di Late (post-TDP,.Profilo.): - In collaborazione con la dermatologia TA Head: Agire come leader chiave nello sviluppo della strategia Ph2-3 e post-approvazione di ragonaggio per i programmi antidroga, rappresentando TMDP sul Global Project Team (GPT) insieme ad altre funzioni della linea TM. - Fornire supporto per la selezione della dose, la progettazione dello studio e altre questioni di farmacologia clinica durante il ciclo di sviluppo.

- Sopravvivere la condotta e l'interpretazione degli studi prioritarizzati dalla sperimentazione pilota, quali popolazioni speciali, interazioni farmaco-farmaco, meccanismi di valutazione dell'azione, Piano di indagine pediatrica, ecc.

Ricerca traslazionale (TR; ricerca di indicazioni, endpoint e sviluppo di biomarcatori): - In collaborazione con la responsabile della dermatologia TA, BR Research scientists, altre funzioni della linea TM (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), sviluppare strategie per identificare le indicazioni iniziali o di espansione (PIE) e per ottenere prove sufficienti per finanziare queste idee.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; componenti per la licenza in licenza e fuori): - Partecipa alle squadre BD&L in qualità di rappresentante del TM.

Responsabilità generali: - Responsabile del monitoraggio clinico e della revisione integrata dei dati di sicurezza durante e dopo la fase in cui si svolge uno studio. - Fornisce la leadership medica e scientifica e la competenza a tutte le funzioni di linea del gruppo di studio. - Rappresentare aspetti clinici della medicina traslazionale alle autorità sanitarie e ad altre parti interessate (ad esempio i contribuenti, i gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti). - Superare la strategia di pubblicazione per gli studi sulla TM; scrivere testate scientifiche; presentare i risultati dello studio esternamente, ove opportuno.

Leadership: - Lead team di studio specifici/squadre di studi clinici in collaborazione con altre funzioni di linea. - Lead BR-sub-team (s) sui team di progetto globali per programmi in fase avanzata - Collaborazione strettamente con altre funzioni di linea TM (in particolare CS&I) e non-TM (in particolare Project Management) per garantire l'eccellenza operativa, la continuità dell'urgenza e la stretta attenzione alle linee temporali, ai costi e agli oneri soggettivi in equilibrio con elevati standard scientifici e innovazione

Requisiti essenziali: - Dottorato, MD - Dermatologa certificata da consiglio - Preferibilmente Ph.D. in dermatologia/immunologia - Almeno 5 anni. esperienza in una società farmaceutica/biotech, CRO, o centro medico accademico, o esperienza correlata - Innovazione: Cerca nuove opportunità di scoperta clinica e approcci per raggiungere TDP - Esperto riconosciuto sul campo, guidando il successo per studi e progetti individuali; rispettato dai colleghi in tutto R&D, Sviluppo, ed esternamente - Fluente orale e scritto inglese

Vantaggi e premi In Novartis, ci siamo impegnati a reimmaginare la medicina insieme e a ricompensare le persone che la fanno accadere.

Range annuale di base previsto per il ruolo: - 122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annua

Jobbeschreibung Zusammenfassung #LI-Hybrid Ort: Basel, Schweiz

Als Translational Medicine Expert (TME) bieten Sie medizinische und wissenschaftliche Expertise und Führung bei: - Führen Sie den Erfolg von frühen globalen Programmen, entwickeln und implementieren Sie Strategien, um Transition Decision Point (TDP) zu erreichen - Antrieb Erfolg von späten globalen Programmen durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die zu klinischen Pharmakologie und Profiling-Pakete führen, die regulatorische Anforderungen erfüllen und differenzierte und wettbewerbsfähige Arzneimittelkennzeichnung unterstützen. - Unterstützung Translational Research bei der Entwicklung neuer Indikationen, Endpunkte und Biomarker, mit In-vitro, in vivo oder in Silico-Methoden.

- Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Expertenbewertungen und Unterstützung für die Lizenzvergabe, einschließlich Due Diligences.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Wichtige Aufgaben: Frühe klinische Projekte (Phase I / II,,Discovery,): - Entwickeln Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit der Dermatologie TA und arbeiten Sie mit Teams an der Durchführung, Strategien für die Translational Medicine Komponente von Medikamentenentwicklungsprojekten von Forschung bis TDP in einzelnen oder mehreren Indikationen, einschließlich Post-Indikations-Erweiterung (PIE) Projekte.

Spätphasen-Klinische Projekte (nach TDP,, ), : - In Zusammenarbeit mit der Dermatologie TA Head: Act als ein wichtiger Führer bei der Entwicklung der Ph2-3 und Post-Genehmigung Profiling-Strategie für Arzneimittel-Programme, die TMDP auf Global Project Team (GPT) zusammen mit anderen TM-Linie Funktionen. - Unterstützung für die Dosisauswahl, Studiendesign und andere klinische Pharmakologie Fragen während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus.

- Überwachen Sie die Durchführung und Interpretation von Studien, die von der Unterstützung der zentralen Studien priorisiert wurden, wie spezielle Populationen, Arzneimittel-Drogen-Interaktionen, Mechanismus der Wirkungsbewertungen, Pediatric Investigation Plan, etc.

Translational Research (TR; Indikationssuche, Endpunkt- und Biomarkerentwicklung): - In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Dermatologie-TA-Leiter, BR-Forschungswissenschaftlern, anderen TM-Line-Funktionen (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), entwickeln Strategien zur Identifizierung von Initial- oder Expansions-Indikationen (PIE) und zur Erlangung ausreichender Nachweise, um diese Ideen zu finanzieren.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; In-Lizenzierung und Ausverkauf von Lizenzierungs-Compounds): - Nehmen Sie als TM-Vertreter an BD&L-Teams teil.

Allgemeine Verantwortung: - Verantwortlich für die klinische Überwachung und integrierte Sicherheitsdatenüberprüfung während und nach der Live-Phase einer Studie. - Bietet medizinische und wissenschaftliche Führung und Expertise für alle Leitungsfunktionen im Studienteam. - Vertreten klinische Translational Medicine Aspekte für Gesundheitsbehörden und andere Stakeholder (z.B. Zahler, Patienten-Advocacy-Gruppen). - Überwachen Sie die Publikationsstrategie für TM-Studien; Leadwriting von wissenschaftlichen Publikationen; präsentieren Sie Studienergebnisse extern, wenn angemessen

Führung: - Leitungsteams/ klinische Testteams in Partnerschaft mit anderen Leitungsfunktionen. - Leitungsteams für BR-Teilteams im Global Project Teams für Spätphasenprogramme - enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen TM (insbesondere CS&I) und Nicht-TM (insbesondere Projektmanagement)-Linienfunktionen, um operative Exzellenz, anhaltende Dringlichkeit und die Aufmerksamkeit auf Zeitlinien, Kosten und Themenlast im Einklang mit hohen wissenschaftlichen Standards und Innovationen zu gewährleisten

Grundlegende Voraussetzungen: - Doktorat, MD - Vorstand zertifiziert Dermatologe - Vorzugsweise Doktorat in der Dermatologie/Immunologie - Mindestens 5 Jahre, Erfahrung in einem Pharma-/Biotech-Unternehmen, CRO, oder akademische medizinische Zentrum, oder verwandte Erfahrung - Innovation: Suche nach neuen klinischen Entdeckungsmöglichkeiten und Ansätzen, um TDP zu erreichen - Erkannter Experte im Bereich, Antriebserfolg für einzelne Studien und Projekte; von Kollegen in Forschung und Entwicklung, Entwicklung und extern respektiert - Fluent oral und schriftlich Englisch

Vorteile & Belohnungen Bei Novartis sind wir verpflichtet, die Medizin zusammen neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die es geschehen lassen.

Erwartete Jahresbasis Gehaltsspanne für die Rolle: - 122.500.00 - 227.500.00 CHF Annua

Description de l'emploi Résumé #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

En tant qu'expert en médecine translationnelle, vous fournirez une expertise médicale et scientifique et un leadership pour : - favoriser la réussite des premiers programmes mondiaux, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies pour atteindre le point de décision de transition (DPT) - favoriser la réussite des programmes mondiaux tardifs en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies qui mènent à la pharmacologie clinique et à des ensembles de profilage qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires et qui appuient l'étiquetage différencié et concurrentiel des médicaments. - appuyer la recherche translationnelle dans l'élaboration de nouvelles indications, critères et biomarqueurs, en utilisant des méthodes in vitro, in vivo ou silico.

- Fournir des évaluations scientifiques et un soutien pour les possibilités de licence, y compris des diligences raisonnables.

Description de l'emploi

Principales responsabilités : Projets cliniques précoces (phase I / II,, Découverte) : - Élaborer, en collaboration avec l'AT dermatologique et travailler avec des équipes pour réaliser, des stratégies pour la composante Médecine Translationnelle des projets de développement de médicaments de la recherche au PDT en une ou plusieurs indications, y compris des projets d'expansion post-Digération (EIP).

Projets cliniques en fin de cycle (après le PDT,,Profilage) : - En collaboration avec le responsable de l'AT de dermatologie : Agir comme chef de file dans l'élaboration de la stratégie de profilage des médicaments Ph2-3 et post-approbation, représentant le PDTG au sein de l'équipe de projet mondial (GPT) et d'autres fonctions de ligne de TG. - Fournir un soutien pour la sélection des doses, la conception des études et d'autres questions de pharmacologie clinique tout au long du cycle de développement.

- Superviser la conduite et l'interprétation des études prioritaires par les essais pivots, tels que les populations spéciales, les interactions drogues-médicaments, le mécanisme d'évaluation des mesures, le Plan d'investigation pédiatrique, etc.

Recherche translationnelle (TR; recherche d'indications, développement de paramètres et de biomarqueurs) : - En collaboration avec le chef de l'AT dermatologique, les chercheurs en BR, d'autres fonctions de ligne de TM (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), élaborer des stratégies pour identifier les indications initiales ou d'expansion (EIP) et obtenir des preuves suffisantes pour financer ces idées.

Développement des entreprises et délivrance de licences (BD&L; composés d'autorisation et de délivrance de licences) : - Participer aux équipes de BD&L en tant que représentant du TM.

Responsabilités générales : - Responsable de la surveillance clinique et de l'examen intégré des données sur l'innocuité pendant et après la phase de vie d'une étude. - Dirige et experte médicalement et scientifiquement toutes les fonctions de l'équipe d'étude. - Représenter les aspects cliniques de la médecine translationnelle aux autorités sanitaires et aux autres intervenants (p. ex., les années 006 et les groupes de défense des patients). - Superviser la stratégie de publication des études sur les TM; diriger la rédaction des publications scientifiques; présenter les résultats de l'étude de l'extérieur, le cas échéant.

Leadership : - Équipes et équipes d'essais cliniques qui sont chargées de diriger des études particulières en partenariat avec d'autres fonctions de la ligne. - Sous-équipes de projet mondial - Collaborez étroitement avec d'autres fonctions de la ligne TM (en particulier CS et I) et non MC (en particulier la gestion de projet) afin d'assurer l'excellence opérationnelle, l'urgence continue et une attention étroite aux délais, aux coûts et au fardeau des sujets en équilibre avec des normes scientifiques élevées et l'innovation

Exigences essentielles : - Doctorat, MD - Dermatologue certifié par le conseil - Doctorat de préférence en dermatologie/immunologie - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans une entreprise pharmaceutique/biotech, un centre de recherche ou un centre médical universitaire, ou expérience connexe - Innovation : recherche de nouvelles possibilités de découverte clinique et de nouvelles approches pour atteindre le PDT - Expert reconnu en matière de recherche, qui a permis de réussir des études et des projets individuels; respecté par des collègues de R-D, de Développement et externe - Anglais oral et écrit

Avantages et récompenses Chez Novartis, nous sommes déterminés à recréer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la rendent possible.

Gamme de salaires de base annuels prévus pour le rôle : - 122 500.00 - 227 500.00 CHF Annua

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This is a leadership role for the AI Systems & Scale group within AI4R and will be tasked with strong technical and project leadership, critical assessment and specialized deployment of compute, data, model, code and agentic platforms for rapid enablement and adoption of AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a leadership role shaping the future of AI at scale, where advanced agentic systems and enterprise AI platforms transform how biomedical research is delivered. As Director & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale), you will drive the design and deployment of next-Generation AI systems, enabling scientists to seamlessly leverage data, models, and intelligent workflows to accelerate drug discovery. You will lead high-performing engineering teams, define scalable architectures, and ensure AI solutions are robust, governed, and impactful—bringing innovative therapies closer to patients faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the multi-year roadmap for scalable AI systems, platforms, and agentic architectures across research.

• Lead and scale multidisciplinary teams delivering production-grade AI systems and intelligent applications.

• Establish reference architectures for agentic systems, including orchestration, retrieval, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Build and standardize enterprise agentic platforms with reusable components, workflows, and evaluation frameworks.

• Define and enforce machine learning operations and large language model operations standards across AI systems development.

• Own agent quality and safety engineering, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and failure detection mechanisms.

• Drive scalable deployment strategies, ensuring performance, reliability, cost efficiency, and multi-tenant architecture.

• Define performance metrics linking system effectiveness to scientific outcomes, including accuracy, robustness, and efficiency.

• Partner with data, security, and platform teams to ensure governance, compliance, and responsible data usage.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration and portfolio management to prioritize high-impact AI system initiatives and reduce duplication.

Essential Requirements

• Demonstrated experience leading machine learning capability development initiatives across multiple drug discovery domains and teams.

• Strong experience applying machine learning across functional areas such as computati

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di insalata: CHF1,46,300.00 - CHF2,71,700.00 Descrizione del lavoro Titolo del lavoro: Direttore & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale) #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Supporto di trasferimento: Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento: si prega di applicare solo se accessibile. Novartis ha abbracciato una strategia coraggiosa per guidare una trasformazione digitale a livello aziendale. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di posizionare Novartis come leader del settore adottando proattivamente tecnologie digitali che favoriscono approcci innovativi per accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Utilizzando dati R&D interni ed esterni con la potenza della scienza dei dati, modelli predittivi, AI generativo e machine learning, il nostro obiettivo è quello di identificare nuovi obiettivi, creare molecole terapeutiche più efficaci, prevedere meglio farmacocinetica e rischi di sicurezza, perfezionare il design di prova clinica e ridurre significativamente i cicli di sviluppo. Il team AI4R conduce Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) nell’esplorazione e nell’applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga e per accelerare e migliorare l’efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Questo è un ruolo di leadership per il gruppo AI Systems & Scale all'interno di AI4R e sarà incaricato di una forte leadership tecnica e di progetto, valutazione critica e distribuzione specializzata di piattaforme di calcolo, dati, modello, codice e agentic per il rapido abilitamento e l'adozione di approcci AI, algoritmi, modelli e flussi di lavoro per massimizzare l'impatto su settori chiave di ricerca biomedica che potrebbero portare a sviluppare farmaci migliori, più veloce. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership plasmando il futuro dell'IA a scala, dove sistemi agentici avanzati e piattaforme AI enterprise trasformano come la ricerca biomedica viene consegnata. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale), guiderai la progettazione e la distribuzione di sistemi AI di prossima generazione, consentendo agli scienziati di sfruttare senza soluzione di continuità dati, modelli e flussi di lavoro intelligenti per accelerare la scoperta della droga. Potrai condurre team di ingegneria ad alte prestazioni, definire architetture scalabili, e garantire soluzioni AI sono robuste, governate e impattanti, portando terapie innovative più vicine ai pazienti più velocemente. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la roadmap pluriennale per sistemi, piattaforme e architetture agentiche scalabili di AI.
• Lead e scale team multidisciplinari che offrono sistemi AI di qualità produttiva e applicazioni intelligenti.
• Stabilire architetture di riferimento per sistemi agentici, tra cui orchestrazione, recupero, memoria e controlli umani-in-the-loop.
• Costruire e standardizzare piattaforme di agentic aziendali con componenti riutilizzabili, flussi di lavoro e framework di valutazione.
• Definire e far rispettare le operazioni di apprendimento automatico e i grandi standard di gestione del modello di lingua nello sviluppo dei sistemi AI.
• ingegneria della qualità e della sicurezza del proprio agente, compresi i sistemi di controllo, di controllo e di rilevamento dei guasti.

Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Novartis a adopté une stratégie audacieuse pour conduire une transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de positionner Novartis comme un leader de l'industrie en adoptant proactivement des technologies numériques qui favorisent des approches novatrices pour accélérer la découverte et le développement de médicaments. En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. AI4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, élève le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en connectant les leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Description de l'emploi Entrer dans un rôle de leadership façonnant l'avenir de l'IA à l'échelle, où les systèmes d'agents de pointe et les plates-formes d'IA d'entreprise transforment la façon dont la recherche biomédicale est réalisée. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (AI-Systems & Scale), vous piloterez la conception et le déploiement de systèmes d'IA de prochaine génération, ce qui permettra aux scientifiques d'exploiter de façon transparente les données, les modèles et les flux de travail intelligents pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments. Vous dirigerez des équipes d'ingénieurs hautement performantes, définirez des architectures évolutives et veillerez à ce que les solutions d'IA soient robustes, gouvernées et efficaces. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour les systèmes, plates-formes et architectures agentsables évolutives de l'IA dans toute la recherche.
• Des équipes multidisciplinaires de pointe et d'échelle fournissant des systèmes d'IA de qualité de production et des applications intelligentes.
• Établir des architectures de référence pour les systèmes d'agents, y compris l'orchestration, la récupération, la mémoire et les contrôles humains en boucle.
• Construire et normaliser des plateformes d'agents d'entreprise avec des composants réutilisables, des flux de travail et des cadres d'évaluation.
• Définir et faire respecter les opérations d'apprentissage automatique et les grandes normes d'exploitation des modèles linguistiques dans l'ensemble du développement des systèmes d'IA.
• Qualité de l'agent et ingénierie de la sécurité, y compris les garde-corps, l'application des politiques et les mécanismes de détection des défaillances.
• Conduire des stratégies de déploiement évolutives, assurant performances, fiabilité, rentabilité et architecture multi-locataires.
• Définir des paramètres de performance reliant l'efficacité du système aux résultats scientifiques, y compris la précision, la robustesse et l'efficience.
• S'associer avec des équipes de données, de sécurité et de plateforme pour assurer la gouvernance, la conformité et une utilisation responsable des données.
• Encourager la collaboration interfonctionnelle et la gestion de portefeuille pour prioriser les initiatives de systèmes d'IA à impact élevé et réduire les doubles emplois. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée menant des initiatives de développement des capacités d'apprentissage automatique dans plusieurs domaines et équipes de découverte de médicaments.
• Forte expérience d'application de l'apprentissage automatique dans des domaines fonctionnels tels que le calcul

Il team AI4R conduce BR nell'esplorazione e nell'applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga, e per accelerare e migliorare l'efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership fondamentale all'avanguardia nell'innovazione scientifica, dove l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia incontra la ricerca biomedica. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (Applied AI), formerai come approcci avanzati di machine learning accelerano la scoperta dei farmaci, traducendo dati complessi in approfondimenti scientifici significativi che possono trasformare i risultati dei pazienti. Potrai condurre collaborazioni ad alto impatto, guidare la direzione strategica AI attraverso i domini di ricerca, e rafforzare i team di spingere i confini di ciò che è possibile nello sviluppo di farmaci migliori, più veloce. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la strategia di intelligenza artificiale applicata e roadmap pluriennale attraverso la ricerca di scoperta della droga.
• Allineare le priorità con le esigenze del portafoglio, le opportunità scientifiche e l'impatto commerciale e di ricerca misurabile.
• Leader team multidisciplinari per identificare, prototipo, benchmark e distribuire soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale fit-for-purpose.
• Governare un portafoglio di intelligenza artificiale applicato con l'assunzione chiara, la priorità, la risonanza, la supervisione della consegna e le metriche di successo.
• Stabilire le migliori pratiche per la definizione dei problemi, la disponibilità dei dati, il benchmarking, la progettazione della valutazione e lo sviluppo del modello riproducibile.
• Promuovere il benchmarking delle fondazioni e dei modelli specifici per le attività, consentendo scambi trasparenti e decisioni di adozione informate.
• Collaborare con i team di ingegneria per scalare le soluzioni e incorporarle nel processo decisionale scientifico quotidiano.
• Definire metriche di valutazione rigorose che collegano le prestazioni del modello a decisioni a valle e risultati sperimentali.
• Costruire una cultura del rigore scientifico, rapida iterazione, mentorship e impatto pratico tra le squadre.
• Forge collaborazioni accademiche e industriali strategiche per accelerare innovazione, benchmarking e trasferimento tecnologico. Requisiti essenziali
• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative di sviluppo delle capacità di apprendimento delle macchine principali tra i team di scoperta della droga e casi di utilizzo.
• Esperienza dimostrata con il modello di base benchmarking nelle applicazioni di scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza pratica sull'applicazione dell'apprendimento automatico

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in führenden Kernentwicklungsinitiativen für maschinelles Lernen in Wirkstoffforschungsteams und Anwendungsfällen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Foundation Model Benchmarking in Wirkstoffforschungsanwendungen.
• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit maschinellem Lernen

Échelle salariale : 1 46 300,00 CHF - 2 71 700,00 CHF Résumé de la description d'emploi Titre du poste: Directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée) #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Soutien à la réinstallation: Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Novartis a adopté une stratégie audacieuse pour conduire une transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de positionner Novartis comme un leader de l'industrie en adoptant proactivement des technologies numériques qui favorisent des approches novatrices pour accélérer la découverte et le développement de médicaments. En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige BR dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. L'IA4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, augmente le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en se connectant aux leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Ce rôle de chef de file pour le groupe AI4R appliqué sera chargé d'assurer un solide leadership technique, d'équipe et de projet, en s' alignant avec les experts en matière biomédicale pour bien comprendre les possibilités de ML dans la découverte de médicaments, l'évaluation du paysage du modèle, l'analyse comparative des modèles et l'application des approches, algorithmes, modèles et flux de travail appropriés en matière d'IA afin de maximiser l'impact sur les domaines clés de la recherche biomédicale qui pourraient mener à la mise au point de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Description de l'emploi Entrez dans un rôle de leadership central à l'avant-garde de l'innovation scientifique, où l'intelligence artificielle de pointe rencontre la recherche biomédicale. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée), vous déterminerez comment l'apprentissage automatique avancé s'approche pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments, transformant des données complexes en données scientifiques significatives qui peuvent transformer les résultats des patients. Vous dirigerez des collaborations à impact élevé, guiderez l'orientation stratégique de l'IA dans tous les domaines de recherche et permettreez aux équipes de repousser les limites de ce qui est possible pour développer de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la stratégie d'intelligence artificielle appliquée et la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour la recherche sur la découverte de médicaments.
• Harmoniser les priorités avec les besoins du portefeuille, les possibilités scientifiques et l'impact mesurable des activités et de la recherche.
• Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires pour identifier, prototyper, comparer et déployer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle adaptées à l'usage.
• Gouvernance d'un portefeuille de renseignements artificiels appliqués comportant des données d'entrée, de priorité, de ressourcement, de surveillance de l'exécution et de mesure du succès.
• Établir des pratiques exemplaires pour l'élaboration des problèmes, la préparation aux données, l'analyse comparative, la conception de l'évaluation et l'élaboration de modèles reproductibles.
• Diriger l'analyse comparative des modèles de base et des modèles spécifiques aux tâches, en permettant des compromis transparents et des décisions d'adoption éclairées.
• Partenaire avec des équipes d'ingénierie pour mettre à l'échelle les solutions et les intégrer dans la prise de décision scientifique quotidienne.
• Définir des mesures d'évaluation rigoureuses reliant le rendement du modèle aux décisions en aval et aux résultats expérimentaux.
• Construire une culture de rigueur scientifique, d'itération rapide, de mentorat et d'impact pratique entre les équipes.
• Forger des collaborations stratégiques entre les universités et l'industrie pour accélérer l'innovation, l'étalonnage et le transfert de technologie. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée dans la conduite d'initiatives de développement de la capacité d'apprentissage automatique au sein des équipes de découverte de médicaments et des cas d'utilisation.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'analyse comparative des modèles de base dans les applications de découverte de médicaments.
• Expérience pratique en appliquant l'apprentissage automatique

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland or Cambridge, United States (see separate posting)

Ready to shape the future of innovation at Novartis? As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 146.300 - CHF 271.700

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental l

En tant qu'avocat en brevets, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la protection des découvertes scientifiques révolutionnaires et dans l'accès aux médicaments qui changent la vie des patients dans le monde entier. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de R-D, vous dirigerez les décisions stratégiques en matière de propriété intellectuelle, créerez de solides portefeuilles de brevets et naviguerez dans des paysages juridiques complexes pour préserver l'innovation tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Fournir des conseils clairs, stratégiques et axés sur les affaires aux clients de la R-D de Novartis sur la protection des inventions, l'élaboration de portefeuilles, la stratégie de publication et les risques pour les tiers.

jobs.title: Director, AI Foundations Engineer- Remote
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.

Job Description
The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Director, AI Foundations Engineer will drive the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.

Major Accountabilities

• Lead the design and development and ongoing improvement of the organization's AI foundations that will enable use cases through a disciplined engineering approach

• Define and implement an agentic AI foundational system, engineering standards, and development practices that promote scalability, reliability, repeatability, and continuous improvement

• Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise needs and strategic priorities.

• Oversee engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that enable agentic AI products and workflows.

• Drive modernization and integration efforts to connect existing systems and processes with AI capabilities.

• Monitor agentic operations and user feedback to identify improvements, resolve issues, and support continuous optimization.

• Establish effective operating models, support processes, and governance practices to ensure consistent delivery of AI capabilities

• Communicate platform priorities, delivery progress, technical risks, and investment needs to senior leaders and cross functional stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.

• 8 plus years of AI engineering experience, with a strong track record of leading product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for complex digital, data, or AI enabled products.

• Demonstrated experience in AI and data driven product environments, including translating business needs into scalable product solutions and partnering closely with technical teams to bring innovative products to market.

• Strong cross functional leadership skills, with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Innovation, Design, Data Science, Commercial, and other business teams to drive alignment and execution.

• Experience managing and developing product managers or junior product leaders, including coaching, prioritization support, and fostering strong product

jobs.title: Senior Principal Scientist - Proteomics
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF126,000.00 - CHF234,000.00

Job Description Summary
We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious, and highly motivated proteomics expert to join our Discovery Sciences Translational Profiling (TP) team in Basel. TP is a global group of experts in proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, super-resolution microscopy, and data science, within Novartis Biomedical Research at our sites in Basel, Switzerland and Cambridge, US.
As a Senior Principal Scientist, you will lead a proteomics lab team, play a pivotal role in advancing our cutting-edge technologies and contribute to our global proteomics strategy. This role involves collaboration with scientists, project teams, and five disease areas across Novartis Biomedical Research, all dedicated to creating and delivering transformative therapeutics to patients worldwide.

Job Description

Internal Job Title : Senior Principal Scientist
Position Location: Basel, CH onsite #LI-onsite

* This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Key Responsibilities:

• Initiate, lead, and oversee high-impact proteomics analyses across drug discovery programs, from early research to translational studies involving patient samples.

• Contribute to interdisciplinary research programs within a collaborative, matrixed environment, partnering across internal cross-functional teams and with external collaborators.

• Maintain a state-of-the-art proteomics platform by staying abreast of technological advancements and aligning capabilities with internal project needs and application priorities.

• Drive innovation in biomedical research by championing advanced technologies and cross-disciplinary initiatives, enabling novel applications of proteomics, such as low-input and spatial proteomics.

• Coach and mentor junior scientists, support project teams, and facilitate the work of direct/matrix reports and key collaborators.

Essential Requirements:

• PhD in biology, biochemistry, or a related discipline, with a minimum of five years of academic experience in proteomics applied to biomedical research, or comparable experience in the biotechnology/pharmaceutical industry.

• Extensive knowledge of and experience with proteomics approaches and technologies, with key applications in biomedical and translational research as demonstrated by a strong publication record and significant contributions to the proteomics field.

• Strong data science skills with a solid understanding of biostatistical principles.

• Proven ability to lead a cross-functional team in a matrix environment.

• Collaborative, innovative mindset with the ability to adapt quickly to a dynamic, fast-paced, multi-disciplinary research environment.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills for multidisciplinary audiences across various seniority and expertise levels.

Desirable Requirements:

• Experience with pathway analysis and multi-omics data integration as well as knowledge of advanced data science approaches, including skills in Python and/or R.

• Expertise in spatial and low input proteomics.

Benefits & Rewards:

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 126.000 - CHF 234.000

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid

Descrizione del lavoro
Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto proteomico entusiasta, curioso e altamente motivato per unirsi al nostro team Discovery Sciences Translational Profiling (TP) di Basilea. TP è un gruppo globale di esperti in proteomica, metabolomica, lipidomica, microscopia super-risoluzione e scienza dei dati, all'interno di Novartis Biomedical Research presso i nostri siti a Basilea, Svizzera e Cambridge, Stati Uniti.
In qualità di Senior Principal Scientist, guiderai un team di laboratorio proteomics, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere le nostre tecnologie all'avanguardia e contribuirai alla nostra strategia proteomica globale. Questo ruolo coinvolge la collaborazione con scienziati, team di progetto e cinque aree di malattia in Novartis Biomedical Research, tutte dedicate alla creazione e alla fornitura di terapeutici trasformativi a pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Descrizione del lavoro

Titolo del lavoro interno: Senior Principal Scientist
Posizione: Basilea, CH in loco #LI-onsite

* Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, in Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo: si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Avviare, guidare e supervisionare le analisi proteomiche ad alto impatto attraverso i programmi di scoperta della droga, dalla ricerca precoce a studi traduttivi che coinvolgono campioni di pazienti.

• Contribuisci a programmi di ricerca interdisciplinari all'interno di un ambiente collaborativo e matrice, collaborando tra team interfunzionali interni e con collaboratori esterni.

• Mantenere una piattaforma proteomica all'avanguardia rimanendo al passo con i progressi tecnologici e le capacità di allineamento con le esigenze interne del progetto e le priorità delle applicazioni.

• Guidare l'innovazione nella ricerca biomedica, sostenendo tecnologie avanzate e iniziative interdisciplinari, consentendo nuove applicazioni di proteomica, come ad esempio la bassa input e la proteomica spaziale.

• Allenatore e mentore giovani scienziati, sostenere team di progetto, e facilitare il lavoro di rapporti diretti / matrice e collaboratori chiave.

Requisiti essenziali:

• Dottorato di ricerca in biologia, biochimica o disciplina correlata, con un minimo di cinque anni di esperienza accademica nella proteomica applicata alla ricerca biomedica, o esperienza comparabile nell'industria biotecnologia/farmaceutica.

• Ampia conoscenza e esperienza con approcci e tecnologie proteomiche, con applicazioni chiave nella ricerca biomedica e traduttiva come dimostrato da un forte record di pubblicazione e contributi significativi al campo proteomics.

• Forte capacità di scienza dei dati con una solida comprensione dei principi biostatistici.

• Prove capacità di condurre una squadra trasversale in un ambiente matrice.

• Mindset collaborativo e innovativo con la capacità di adattarsi rapidamente ad un ambiente di ricerca dinamico, veloce e multidisciplinare.

• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e presentazione per il pubblico multidisciplinare attraverso vari livelli di seniority e competenze.

Requisiti discreti:

• Esperienza con l'analisi del percorso e l'integrazione dei dati multi-omica, nonché la conoscenza degli approcci avanzati di data science, comprese le competenze in Python e/o R.

• Competenza nella proteomica spaziale e a basso input.

Vantaggi e premi:

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: CHF 126.000 - CHF 234.000

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come competenze rilevanti, competenze ed esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, ove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane pagate

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
Wir suchen einen begeisterten, neugierigen und hochmotivierten Experten für Proteomik, der sich unserem Discovery Sciences Translational Profiling (TP) Team in Basel anschließt. TP ist eine globale Expertengruppe für Proteomik, Metabolomik, Lipidomik, Superauflösungsmikroskopie und Data Science innerhalb von Novartis Biomedical Research an unseren Standorten in Basel, Schweiz und Cambridge, USA.
Als Senior Principal Scientist leiten Sie ein Proteomics-Laborteam, spielen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Spitzentechnologien und tragen zu unserer globalen Proteomics-Strategie bei. Diese Rolle umfasst die Zusammenarbeit mit Wissenschaftlern, Projektteams und fünf Krankheitsgebieten in Novartis Biomedical Research, die sich alle der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung transformativer Therapeutika für Patienten weltweit widmen.

Stellenbeschreibung

Interne Berufsbezeichnung: Senior Principal Scientist
Position Standort: Basel, CH vor Ort #LI-onsite

* Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, Schweiz. Novartis kann keine Umzugsunterstützung für diese Rolle anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn dieser Standort für Sie zugänglich ist.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Initiieren, leiten und beaufsichtigen Sie hochwirksame Proteomikanalysen über Wirkstoffforschungsprogramme hinweg, von der frühen Forschung bis hin zu translationalen Studien mit Patientenproben.

• Tragen Sie zu interdisziplinären Forschungsprogrammen in einer kollaborativen, matrixförmigen Umgebung bei und arbeiten Sie mit internen funktionsübergreifenden Teams und externen Mitarbeitern zusammen.

• Pflegen Sie eine hochmoderne Proteomikplattform, indem Sie über technologische Fortschritte auf dem Laufenden bleiben und die Fähigkeiten an den internen Projektanforderungen und Anwendungsprioritäten ausrichten.

• Förderung der Innovation in der biomedizinischen Forschung durch die Förderung fortschrittlicher Technologien und interdisziplinärer Initiativen, die neuartige Anwendungen der Proteomik ermöglichen, wie etwa die Proteomik mit niedrigem Input und die räumliche Proteomik.

• Coach und Mentor Nachwuchswissenschaftler, unterstützen Projektteams und erleichtern die Arbeit von direkten / Matrix-Berichten und wichtigen Mitarbeitern.

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #hybrid

Role Purpose:
Provide specialist knowledge and guidance on sterile and low bioburden processes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Implement, harmonize, and continuously improve aseptic standards and best practices across TRD pilot plants and all modalities (Cell and Gene Therapies, Radioligand Therapies, ADC, and New Biological Entities).

Act as a key partner in cross-functional projects, troubleshooting issues and aligning stakeholders on pragmatic solutions and standards. Mentor and develop members of the TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, addressing critical skills gaps.

Job Description
Major Accountabilities:

• Establish, lead, and continuously develop a TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, fostering accountability, learning, and collaboration.

• Provide specialist knowledge and guidance on sterile and low bioburden processes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Implement, harmonize, and continuously improve aseptic standards and best practices across TRD pilot plants and across all modalities (Cell and Gene Therapies, Radioligand Therapies, ADC, and New Biological Entities).

• Drive continuous improvement, knowledge transfer, and innovation in sterility assurance.

• Act as a key partner in cross-functional projects, troubleshooting issues and aligning stakeholders on pragmatic solutions and standards.

• Mentor and develop members of the TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, addressing critical skills gaps.

• Consult on the evaluation and selection of external contractors for aseptic appropriateness, ensuring integrity of outsourced processes.

Desired skills:

• Influence without authority in a matrix environment—build credibility, align stakeholders, and drive standards adoption.

• Proactive relationship-building—actively engage cross-functional partners to create momentum for change.

• Pragmatic risk-taking—balance diligence with smart, solution-oriented decision-making.

• Advanced problem-solving—lead troubleshooting and resolution across departmental boundaries.

• Effective communication—tailor messaging, negotiate, and handle pushback diplomatically.

• Political savvy—navigate informal networks and overcome barriers to secure a seat at the table.

Qualifications

• Advanced degree (PhD, MSc, or equivalent) in life sciences, pharmacy, or related field

• Extensive experience in sterile manufacturing, quality assurance, or related areas within the pharmaceutical/biotech industry

• Strong knowledge of aseptic processing, sterility assurance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH)

• Proven track record in leading cross-functional teams or networks, ideally in a matrix environment

• Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive change across organizational boundaries

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• Fluent in English; additional languages a plus

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: €133,700 to €248,300

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Internal Title: Senior Associate, Clinical Data Strategy
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Responsible for implementing high-quality, data strategy planning within clinical programs, supporting downstream clinical assessment identification and selection, data collection consistency and facilitating robust, rapid decision-making across the Translational Medicine portfolio. The role supports the development and execution of indication, program and trial Data Strategy Plans, ensuring alignment of data collection with scientific and operational objectives and enabling effective handoff to clinical trial teams for execution

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Execute/support end-to-end data strategy activities at the trial and program level, including a) development of Data Strategy Plans to support early data planning and risk assessment, and b) downstream data oversight through subject matter guidance around data visualization and exploration to ensure high-quality outputs that support clinical trial teams and enable data-driven decision-making.

• Contribute to early data strategy landscaping at the indication and focus area level by utilizing internal and external data sources (e.g., internal data repositories, articles/RWE data) to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for supporting trial design and translating these into fit-for-purpose data collection and oversight approaches at the study level.

• Advise on the selection, implementation, risk assessment and oversight of appropriate clinical assessments to support assigned clinical trials, particularly in the Neuroscience Therapeutic Area, with an understanding of population challenges, patient/caregiver/assessor needs and preferences and the criticality of consistency in collection and analysis.

Essential Requirements:

• Multi-year experience in the pharmaceutical, CRO, hospital or healthcare setting, ideally with a strong foundation in clinical trial planning/strategy and data collection/oversight

• Robust knowledge and management of COAs/PROs and specific assessments used in Neuroscience trials and patient populations (ideally with additional knowledge in other therapeutic areas)

• Knowledge of drug development processes and regulations

• Ability to prioritize effectively and work adaptably in a fast-paced environment, and to be comfortable with ambiguity, changing needs and with global, multi-disciplinary teams

• Consultare la selezione, l'implementazione, la valutazione del rischio e la supervisione di adeguate valutazioni cliniche per sostenere gli studi clinici assegnati, in particolare nell'Area Terapeutica di Neuroscienze, con una comprensione delle sfide della popolazione, dei bisogni e delle preferenze del paziente/caregiver/assessor e della criticità della consistenza nella raccolta e nell'analisi.

Requisiti essenziali:

• Esperienza pluriennale nell'ambiente farmaceutico, CRO, ospedaliero o sanitario, idealmente con una solida base nella pianificazione clinica/strategia e raccolta dati/sovrapposizione

• Robusta conoscenza e gestione di COAs/PRO e valutazioni specifiche utilizzate nelle prove di neuroscienza e nelle popolazioni dei pazienti (probabilmente con ulteriori conoscenze in altre aree terapeutiche)

• Conoscenza dei processi di sviluppo della droga e dei regolamenti

• Capacità di privilegiare efficacemente e lavorare in modo adattabile in un ambiente frenetico, e di essere a proprio agio con ambiguità, mutevoli esigenze e con team globali e multidisciplinari

• Ottima comunicazione e collaborazione.

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: Senior Associate, Clinical Data Strategy
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Responsible for implementing high-quality, data strategy planning within clinical programs, supporting downstream clinical assessment identification and selection, data collection consistency and facilitating robust, rapid decision-making across the Translational Medicine portfolio. The role supports the development and execution of indication, program and trial Data Strategy Plans, ensuring alignment of data collection with scientific and operational objectives and enabling effective handoff to clinical trial teams for execution

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Execute/support end-to-end data strategy activities at the trial and program level, including a) development of Data Strategy Plans to support early data planning and risk assessment, and b) downstream data oversight through subject matter guidance around data visualization and exploration to ensure high-quality outputs that support clinical trial teams and enable data-driven decision-making.

• Contribute to early data strategy landscaping at the indication and focus area level by utilizing internal and external data sources (e.g., internal data repositories, articles/RWE data) to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for supporting trial design and translating these into fit-for-purpose data collection and oversight approaches at the study level.

• Advise on the selection, implementation, risk assessment and oversight of appropriate clinical assessments to support assigned clinical trials, particularly in the Neuroscience Therapeutic Area, with an understanding of population challenges, patient/caregiver/assessor needs and preferences and the criticality of consistency in collection and analysis.

Essential Requirements:

• Multi-year experience in the pharmaceutical, CRO, hospital or healthcare setting, ideally with a strong foundation in clinical trial planning/strategy and data collection/oversight

• Robust knowledge and management of COAs/PROs and specific assessments used in Neuroscience trials and patient populations (ideally with additional knowledge in other therapeutic areas)

• Knowledge of drug development processes and regulations

• Ability to prioritize effectively and work adaptably in a fast-paced environment, and to be comfortable with ambiguity, changing needs and with global, multi-disciplinary teams

• Excellent communication and collaboration.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• 93,800.00 - 174,200.00 CHF Annual

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect,

#LI-Hybrid

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid
Titre interne : Associé principal, Stratégie de données cliniques
Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

Responsable de la mise en oeuvre de la planification de la stratégie de données de haute qualité dans le cadre des programmes cliniques, de l'appui à l'identification et à la sélection des évaluations cliniques en aval, de la cohérence de la collecte des données et de la facilitation d'une prise de décisions rapide et robuste dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de la médecine translationnelle. Le rôle appuie l'élaboration et l'exécution de plans de stratégie sur les données d'indication, de programme et d'essai, en assurant l'alignement de la collecte de données sur les objectifs scientifiques et opérationnels et en permettant une remise efficace aux équipes d'essais cliniques pour exécution.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Exécuter/soutenir des activités de stratégie de données de bout en bout au niveau des essais et des programmes, y compris a) l'élaboration de plans de stratégie de données pour appuyer la planification précoce des données et l'évaluation des risques, et b) la surveillance des données en aval au moyen d'orientations sur la visualisation et l'exploration des données afin d'assurer des extrants de haute qualité qui appuient les équipes d'essais cliniques et permettent la prise de décisions fondées sur les données.

• Contribuer à l'aménagement paysager des premières données au niveau de l'indication et de la zone d'intérêt en utilisant des sources de données internes et externes (p. ex., répertoires de données internes, articles/données RWE) pour déterminer les tendances, les idées et les possibilités d'appuyer la conception d'essais et de les traduire en méthodes de collecte et de surveillance de données adaptées aux besoins au niveau de l'étude.

• Conseiller sur la sélection, la mise en oeuvre, l'évaluation des risques et la surveillance des évaluations cliniques appropriées pour appuyer les essais cliniques assignés, en particulier dans le domaine des neurosciences thérapeutiques, en comprenant les défis démographiques, les besoins et les préférences des patients, des soignants et des évaluateurs et la criticité de la cohérence dans la collecte et l'analyse.

Exigences essentielles:

• Expérience pluriannuelle dans le milieu pharmaceutique, le CRO, l'hôpital ou les soins de santé, idéalement avec une solide base dans la planification/stratégie des essais cliniques et la collecte/la surveillance des données

• Connaissances et gestion solides des ACO/PRO et évaluations spécifiques utilisées dans les essais de neurosciences et les populations de patients (idéalement avec des connaissances supplémentaires dans d'autres domaines thérapeutiques)

• Connaissance des processus et des règlements de développement des médicaments

• Capacité d'établir des priorités efficaces et de travailler de façon adaptée dans un environnement à rythme rapide, et d'être à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté, l'évolution des besoins et les équipes multidisciplinaires mondiales

• Excellente communication et collaboration.

Avantages et récompenses
À Novartis, nous nous engageons à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui y arrivent.

Échelle salariale annuelle de base prévue pour le rôle :

Le salaire de base offert est déterminé en fonction d'objectifs non sexistes, tels que les compétences, les compétences et l'expérience pertinentes conformément à la politique d'établissement de la rémunération de Novartis et lors de son adhésion à Novartis sera examiné périodiquement.

En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à une prime basée sur le rendement selon certains paramètres de rendement.

Les récompenses de faire partie de notre équipe vont bien au-delà du salaire de base et des incitatifs. De plus, nous offrons des options de travail flexibles et hybrides, si possible, et un congé parental rémunéré minimum de 14 semaines.

En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à une prime basée sur le rendement selon certains paramètres de rendement. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

We’re a team of dedicated international lawyers united by our purpose to reimagine medicine for patients in need and our drive to achieve together.

As a member of the Legal Leadership Team for Commercial, Medical and Value & Access in International at our Basel HQ you will lead a team of lawyers, providing strategic legal counsel and serving as a trusted business partner to the Immunology and CRM Therapeutic Area (TA) Leadership Team, as well as leaders in Medical Affairs, Value & Access, Development, and other key decision makers across the organization. Together with your team, you will oversee Therapeutic Area assets and related alliances across the Development and Commercialization continuum. By staying informed of the latest developments, you will advise on all critical legal and risk management issues that could influence both the immediate and long-term success and reputation of the business and Novartis.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Strategic Legal Counsel/Leadership – Serve as the lead legal advisor for the Therapeutic Area (TA) and its assets, overseeing all business-related legal matters. Proactively manage legal issues by working closely with your team and collaborating with Legal Centers of Excellence both within and outside the CLS Legal Team, as appropriate. Provide strategic legal counsel on TA and asset strategies, brand plans, portfolio decisions, and related medical activities and engagements. Advise on value and access matters, management of external partners, integrations, investor relations, communications, and patient advocacy initiatives. Participate in business leadership meetings and governance boards for all matters related to the TA and its assets, as required.

• Risk Management/Compliance/Training - Partner with the Ethics, Risk, and Compliance Function to proactively identify, manage and train on potential legal and compliance risks. Ensure legal compliance with all government regulations and mandates. Contribute to investigations and support the follow-up of audit findings as needed to address potential legal or compliance concerns.

• Agreements/Commercial Contracts – Provide legal counsel and risk management for all contracts supporting TA activities. Lead the drafting and negotiation of various types of complex research, development and commercial contracts, as well as any other agreements required to meet the business needs of the TA.

• Business Development/M&A/Integrations – Partner with the Transactions Team and support evaluation and due diligence of business development and M&A opportunities as needed. Lead the advice for the company’s Alliance Management Team and legal issue management for all third-party relationships related to the TA and its assets. Lead the integration of assets and companies into International within TA scope and coordinate with all relevant stakeholders.

• Regulatory/Promotional Materials Review/Claims Management – Collaborate with commercial, regulatory, and medical teams to ensure the timely review of all promotional materials, medical resources, congress materials, public announcements, and investor relations content. Provide proactive legal counsel, identifying and addressing potential risks. Coordinate with other legal associates supporting the brand to maintain consistency. Lead and ensure alignment of brand strategy and claims management across International markets, including the management and defense of competitive claims.

• Innovation – Drive innovation and actively contribute to new strategies supporting TA goals with significant emphasis on product launches and new ways of engagement with our customers (HCPs, Patients, HCs). Lead the team through unfamiliar territory and complexity. Pursue calculated risk-taking in an unpredictable environment with appropriate contingency planning and mitigation.
